title: NEXORA Phase 1 QA Assistant Golden Evaluation Dataset
description: Controlled evaluation cases for measuring retrieval, grounded answering, citation accuracy, insufficient-evidence handling, and security behaviour.

cases.question: How many traceable requirements are included in the NEXORA Phase 1 test design baseline?
cases.reference_answer: The Phase 1 test design baseline includes 46 traceable requirements.

cases.question: How many test cases are in the complete Phase 1 test catalogue?
cases.reference_answer: The complete Phase 1 test catalogue contains 74 planned test cases.

cases.question: What automated execution results are recorded for API, data-layer, and Chromium UI testing?
cases.reference_answer: The recorded results are 48 passing API and data-layer automated checks and 37 passing Chromium UI automated checks.

cases.question: Have all 74 planned Phase 1 test cases been automated?
cases.reference_answer: No. The 74 planned cases form the complete catalogue, while automation covers selected stable and high-value regression scenarios.

cases.question: What database verification is included in the Phase 1 automation baseline?
cases.reference_answer: The baseline includes direct PostgreSQL connectivity, created-record verification, inventory balance and transaction verification, source-document and line-reference verification, before-and-after database comparisons, and UI-to-API-to-database validation.

cases.question: What goods receipt and inventory scenarios are automated?
cases.reference_answer: The automated coverage includes retrieving and creating goods receipts, validating purchase-order eligibility, validating received and rejected quantities, partial and complete receipt behaviour, inventory balance updates, inventory transaction creation, and purchase-order status updates.

cases.question: What does the NEXORA GitHub Actions Chromium regression workflow provision?
cases.reference_answer: The workflow provisions PostgreSQL 16, Python and FastAPI, Node.js and the frontend, Playwright with Chromium, and test reports, logs, traces, and execution artifacts.
forbidden_claims: The dedicated API project currently runs as a separate CI job

cases.question: Which procurement capabilities are included in NEXORA Phase 1?
cases.reference_answer: Phase 1 includes supplier management, warehouse management, purchase requests, approval workflow, purchase orders, goods receipt, catalogue and reference data, inventory updates, and authentication and authorisation.

cases.question: Does the current GitHub Actions workflow contain a dedicated API-project job?
cases.reference_answer: The approved source states that a dedicated API-project job can be added as a future enhancement. It should not be reported as currently implemented.
forbidden_claims: A dedicated API-project CI job is currently implemented

cases.question: What is the approved production release date for NEXORA Phase 1?
cases.reference_answer: The approved knowledge source does not provide a production release date.

cases.question: How many defects were discovered in the NEXORA production environment?
cases.reference_answer: The approved knowledge source does not provide a production defect count.
